Postmarked Cedar Falls, May 12, 1948.
Dear Bess, the lake was flat as window glass and I rowed us clear past the reeds before you noticed we had left the dock. Yours always, Harold.

Postmarked Cedar Falls, November 3, 1948.
Dear Bess, you waltzed the soles clean off my good shoes at the harvest dance and I would do it again tonight. Yours always, Harold.

Postmarked Cedar Falls, June 19, 1949.
Dear Bess, I asked your father twice because my voice failed the first time, and he said yes both times. Meet me on the front porch Sunday. Yours always, Harold.

# Harold & Bess — 70th Anniversary Reading Program
